gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-tagalog: Press Start 2P makes the loud first impression, its letters pinned far apart like cut-outs. Noto Sans Tagalog does the quieter work, a sans whose generous curve gaps and dominant middle zone fill the line.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-tagbanwa: Fun and retro, Press Start 2P pins its letters far apart like cut-outs, with a gentle ebb in stroke weight. Noto Sans Tagbanwa's open curves keep paragraphs flowing without fuss.
